################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the waic results of the experiments 
################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("00_pck.R")
library(colorspace)
dirs$outputs <- "outputs/perpathogen"
dirs$tables <- "outputs/tables"

pat_l <- c("rota", "varicella", "measles", "mumps", "rubella", "men", "pn", "polio", "hib",
           "dipht", "tetan", "pertu", "hbv")
```

Considering that some models do not converge at all, we want to see where are the problems. 

# Checking if the cs2i models converged 
```{r}
# Read the summary of the models 
mod_l <- list() 
for (pathogen in pat_l) {
  mod_l[[pathogen]] <- bake(glue("{dirs$tables}/rhat_{pathogen}_tbl.rds"), {
    sapply(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}")), "cs2i"), function(x) {
      summary(readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}/{x}")))
    }, simplify = FALSE)
  })
}

# Extract the maximum Rhat (>1 means that it did not converge)
for (pathogen in pat_l) {
  bind_rows(lapply(mod_l[[pathogen]], function(x) {
    x$fixed %>%
      bind_rows(x[[1]]$spec_pars) %>%
      bind_rows(x[[1]]$random$study) %>%
      bind_rows(x[[1]]$random$`study:country:center:rct_group`) %>%
      filter(Rhat == max(Rhat))}), .id = "mod") %>%
    mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 2)) %>%
    filter(Rhat != 1) %>%
    separate(mod, into = c("mod", "df"), sep = "_df") %>%
    arrange(df) %>%
    print()
}
# Rota works until kgc3! 
# Polio works until kgc3 and kgc2!

# Extract all disfunctional Rhats and arrange by how disfunctional they are 
test <- list()
for (pathogen in pat_l) {
  test[[pathogen]] <- bind_rows(lapply(mod_l[[pathogen]], function(x) {
    x$fixed %>%
      bind_rows(x[[1]]$spec_pars) %>%
      bind_rows(x[[1]]$random$study) %>%
      bind_rows(x[[1]]$random$`study:country:center:rct_group`) %>%
      arrange(desc(Rhat))}), .id = "mod") %>%
    mutate(Rhat = round(Rhat, digits = 2)) %>%
    filter(Rhat != 1) %>%
    separate(mod, into = c("mod", "df"), sep = "_df") %>%
    arrange(df) %>%
    print()
}

bind_rows(test, .id = "pathogen") %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "parameter") %>%
  mutate(parameter_type = case_when(str_detect(parameter, "sin|cos") ~ "cosine",
                                    str_detect(parameter, "kgc") ~ "kgc", 
                                    str_detect(parameter, "reg") ~ "reg",
                                    str_detect(parameter, "vac") ~ "vac",
                                    str_detect(parameter, "Inter") ~ "int",
                                    str_detect(parameter, "sex") ~ "sex",
                                    str_detect(parameter, "age") ~ "age",
                                    str_detect(parameter, "time") ~ "time"
                                    )) %>%
  select(pathogen, parameter, parameter_type, mod, df, Rhat, Estimate, Est.Error) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, parameter_type, mod, df) %>%
  summarise(Rhat = mean(Rhat)) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, parameter_type) %>%
  #summarise(Rhat = mean(Rhat)) %>%
  arrange(desc(Rhat)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Rhat, y = reorder(parameter_type, Rhat), color = pathogen)) + 
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.2) + 
  scale_x_continuous(trans = "log") + 
  scale_color_viridis_d()
```

# Read data
```{r}
play_dat <- readRDS(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/{pathogen}/data_brms_{pathogen}_vl_s08.rds"))
unique(play_dat$country)

set.seed(1000)
test_dat <- play_dat[sample(1:length(play_dat$pid), 3000),] %>%
  mutate(reg_6a = as.factor(as.character(reg_6a)),
         kgc_1 = as.factor(as.character(kgc_1)))

test_dat %>%
  group_by(kgc_1, reg_6a) %>%
  summarise(n())

class(test_dat$kgc_1)
```

# Run the model
```{r}
# The original cs2i model 
play_mod <- bake("outputs/TESTS/play_mod.rds", {
  brm(formula = imm_val_s1 | cens(censored) ~ 1 + sex + age + 
        (1 | study) + (1 | study:country:center:rct_group) + 
        kgc_1 * cos(pi_vac_week_v1) + kgc_1 * sin(pi_vac_week_v1) + 
        reg_6a * cos(pi_vac_week_v1) + reg_6a * sin(pi_vac_week_v1) + 
        time_vl_s1,
  data = test_dat, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  save_all_pars = TRUE) 
  })

# Intercept set to 0 
play_mod2 <- bake("outputs/TESTS/play_mod2.rds", {
  brm(formula = imm_val_s1 | cens(censored) ~ 0 + sex + age + 
        (1 | study) + (1 | study:country:center:rct_group) + 
        kgc_1 * cos(pi_vac_week_v1) + kgc_1 * sin(pi_vac_week_v1) + 
        reg_6a * cos(pi_vac_week_v1) + reg_6a * sin(pi_vac_week_v1) + 
        time_vl_s1,
  data = test_dat, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  save_all_pars = TRUE) 
  })

# Nonlinear formulas

play_mod25 <- bake("outputs/TESTS/play_mod25.rds", {
  brm(formula = bf(
    imm_val_s1 | cens(censored) ~ a,
      a ~ 1 + sex_c + (1 | study) + (1 | study:country:center:rct_group), 
    nl = TRUE),
  data = test_dat2, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  save_all_pars = TRUE)
  })

play_mod26 <- bake("outputs/TESTS/play_mod26.rds", {
  brm(formula = bf(
    imm_val_s1 | cens(censored) ~ a + b,
      a ~ 1 + (1 | study) + (1 | study:country:center:rct_group), 
      b ~ sex_c,
    nl = TRUE),
  data = test_dat2, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
  init = 0, control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95),
  save_all_pars = TRUE)
  })

play_mod27 <- bake("outputs/TESTS/play_mod27.rds", {
  brm(formula = bf(
    imm_val_s1 | cens(censored) ~ a + b,
      a ~ 1 + (1 | study) + (1 | study:country:center:rct_group), 
      b ~ 0 + sex_c,
    nl = TRUE),
  data = test_dat2, family = Gamma(link = "log"),
  warmup = 1000, iter = 3000, chains = 1,
```
